description: Adds a scheduled task that recompresses the JPEG, PNG and WebP images found in the Jellyfin metadata folder and in the library folders you choose, using the image encoder built into Jellyfin (no external tools needed). The JPEG/WebP quality and the folders to process are set from a page in the dashboard sidebar. Each processed file is marked, so it is never compressed twice. The task is queued automatically after a library scan.
name: Images compressor
overview: Recompresses the images of the metadata folder and of the libraries to save disk space
